items.synopsis: In EVPN-VXLAN scenario DHCP does not work for clients connected on the dot1x port
items.description: On EX4300-48MP, in case of dot1x EVPN-VXLAN dynamic VLAN due to a HW setting which is used to assign VLAN to the authenticated dynamic VLAN, causes the DHCP offer to get tagged.

items.synopsis: On EX2300/EX3400, unexpected error message during OAM boot
items.description: It is not able to get active package date in OAM boot. Instead of getting active package date get the snapshot package date while in OAM/snapshot boot. Added set_pkgset & /packages/sets/$pkgset instead of /packages/sets/active. It will get package date correctly in normal boot, USB snapshot boot, and recovery snapshot boot.

items.synopsis: nfx-3: non-root user is unable to access vnf through ssh, telnet and console
items.description: nfx-3: non-root user is unable to access vnf through ssh, telnet and console

items.synopsis: Error messages are observed and incorrect values are returned for SNMP requests for pfe traffic statistics
items.description: pfed: PFED_NOTIF_GLOBAL_STAT_UNKNOWN: xxxx in syslog The above log messages will be seen when we are using SNMP and if its trying to poll "show pfe statistics notification" through MIB OID - 1.3.6.1.4.1.2636.3.44.1.1.2.1.2.

items.synopsis: The mib2d process crashes during PIC offline/online
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, the mib2d process can crash when the PIC (Physical Interface Cards) is offlined/onlined. Till the mib2d process restarts after the crash, any SNMP query for statistics from PFE (Packet Forwadring Engine) will not get a successful response.

items.synopsis: The Firewall filter with syslog action will not work when applied on the ingress of a loopback interface
items.description: The firewall filter with syslog action on lo0 does not work as expected due to which logs are not seen on the log file.

items.synopsis: Commit confirm and commit race condition crashes the firewall functionality
items.description: On dual-RE (Routing Engine) Junos Evolved platforms, when the commit is executed during the commit confirm timeout window, it causes the firewalld to stop working.

items.synopsis: EX4400 shaping rate not working as expected
items.description: On EX platforms shaping rate on 100gig link over 70g not working as expected.

items.synopsis: LLDP will not work on HGoE VC mode with 40G VCP connections
items.description: On EX4400/QFX5120 platforms, having High Gigabit over Ethernet (HGoE) Virtual Chassis (VC) mode in the master, when VC members are connected by 40G links, Link Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP) Bridge Protocol Data Unit (BPDU) from VC master destined to the remote VC members (more than one-hop away) are dropped at VCP interface due to Virtual LANs (VLANs) membership check.

items.synopsis: Packet drop will be observed due to ARP resolution failure in EVPN-VXLAN scenario
items.description: On Junos ACX/SRX/QFX/EX (BROADCOM based) platforms, ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) resolution is unsuccessful and packet drop will be seen, when interface mode - access is configured in EVPN-VXLAN (Ethernet VPN-Virtual Extensible LAN) ERB (Edge Routed Bridging) scenario.

items.synopsis: Connectivity fails intermittently on 802.1x enabled ports
items.description: On EX4100 and EX4400 platforms performing as Virtual Chassis, host authentication will get stuck in connecting state if 802.1x dynamic VLAN single supplicant mode is enabled on access switch port and complete traffic towards that port will be dropped.

items.synopsis: In Q-in-Q push/pop configuration for double tagged protocol traffic it is seen that the third VLAN tag is getting swapped instead of getting pushed onto the stack
items.description: On Junos EX4350/EX4650-48Y/QFX5120/QFX5120-32C/QFX5120-48Y/QFX5120-48T/EX4400/EX4100 platforms, it is observed that during Q-in-Q push/pop configuration when double tagged protocol traffic like BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) /RIP (Routing Information Protocol) /OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) etc. packets are send towards UNI (User to Network Interface), the third tag is not getting added using firewall rule instead a swap operation is being done and the packet is forwarded as double-tagged. As a result, next device drops the traffic because expectation on that node is triple tagged frames.

items.synopsis: Memory initialization of large blocks causes traffic congestion in PFE or feature configuration fails
items.description: Memory initialization of large blocks of PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) memory such as hash table initialization expands memory which fails due to over-utilization and causes traffic congestion or feature configuration failure.

items.synopsis: The rpd process might crash when SPF is recalculated
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, the rpd (Routing Protocol Daemon) process can crash due to periodic SPF (Shortest Path first) recalculation when ISIS (Intermediate System to Intermediate System) connected or direct routes get deleted.

items.synopsis: Stale entries present in the lsdist table after ISO address change
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms configured with IS-IS and MPLS traffic engineering database (TED), if there is an ISO address change on another Intermediate System (IS), there will be stale entries being present in the link-state distribution (lsdist) table even though they might have been deleted in IS-IS and TED. This has an impact on the routes, and thus the services, related to the stale entries present in the lsdist.

items.synopsis: DHCP binding is not happening in EVPN VXLAN topology with DHCP stateless relay (forward-only)
items.description: In EVPN VXLAN topology with DHCP stateless relay (forward-only) configured at layer 3 gateways, Jdhcpd broadcasts snooped unicast offer packets. That leads to the offer getting dropped on its way to the client and then the IP negotiation fails.

items.synopsis: DHCPv6 security functionality gets effected as DHCPv6 security bindings are not present
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms having DHCPv6 snooping configured, when DHCP-security is enabled on multiple vlans along with dhcp stateless relay enabled at that time, DHCPv6 security bindings are not happening.

items.synopsis: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms the l2ald process memory usage is seen to increase over time
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms service impact is seen due to a consistent increase in l2ald (Layer 2 Address Learning Daemon) memory usage. The extra memory is a result of tools to track memory usage added via PR1536530.

items.synopsis: The l2ald crashes when there is recursive deletion of IFBD or when BGP neighborship is cleared in EVPN-VXLAN multi-homed configuration
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, in a rare scenario, due to timing issue, the l2ald (Layer 2 Address Learning Daemon) crashes and traffic is being blackholed due to recursive deletion of IFBD (Interface Family Bridge Domain) or when BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) neighborship is cleared when EVPN (Ethernet Virtual Private Network) - VXLAN (Virtual Extensible Local Area Network) with multi-homed is configured.

items.synopsis: The rpd process will crash when rpd is restarted
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, when MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching) statistics is configured without LSP (Label-Switched Path) configuration, the rpd process will crash and impact the routing protocols. This leads to traffic disruption due to the loss of routing information.

items.synopsis: Traffic blackhole due to an additional label when CCNH is toggled
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, with scaled Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) routes, when Chained Composite Next Hops (CCNH) is toggled, a few next-hops end up creating additional labels causing a traffic blackhole.

items.synopsis: MPC10E line card crashes when it reboots after FPC firmware upgrade
items.description: On MX240/MX480/MX960 platforms, if Precision time protocol (PTP) is configured, MPC10E line card crashes continuously after FPC firmware upgrade and when MPC10E line card is rebooted. Due to this issue, the clksyncd module also crashes.

items.synopsis: Routing Protocol session down with native VLAN configuration on MX platforms
items.description: On certain Junos MX platforms, the IS-IS (Intermediate System to Intermediate System) sessions will not come up/keep flapping when the native VLAN (Virtual Local Area Network) is configured on the associated l3 interface. There will be traffic loss due to the routing protocols being down and the workaround for the issue is to remove the native VLAN configuration.

items.synopsis: Device is not able to boot up from the recovery OAM volume
items.description: OAM (Operation Administration and Maintenance) snapshot recovery not working as expected, post "request system reboot oam" system should boot OAM recovery mode, but system is rebooting back with current installed image.

items.synopsis: Control plane flap, data drop, unexpected behavior of PFE or device is observed when file storage is impacted in a continuous ksyncd process crash scenario
items.description: On all Junos platforms configured with GRES (Graceful Routing Engine Switchover), file storage in the system will get affected when the ksyncd process crashes continuously and result in control plane flap, data drop or unexpected behavior of PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) or device.

items.synopsis: Routing Engine-initiated PING failed over MPLS interface
items.description: The Routing Engine-generated packets that have an MTU size greater than the inet MTU size get dropped when going out on an interface with MPLS chain-composite-next-hop configured.

items.synopsis: The TCP sessions for BGP are closed on the backup RE
items.description: On all Junos Platforms, if the interface configuration is altered to switch from one routing instance to another it might result in the closing of BGP session on the Backup Routing Engine.

items.synopsis: Master and Backup RE synchronization issue will be seen if chassisd is restarted on Master RE
items.description: On all Junos platforms with GRES (Graceful Routing Engine Switchover) and NSR (Non Stop Routing) enabled, Master and Backup RE (Routing-Engine) synchronization issues will be seen when chassisd (Chassis process) is restarted on Master RE. The ksyncd (Kernel Synchronization) process crash will be observed on the backup RE. If failover happens post this event, traffic would be impacted. This is a rare issue.

items.synopsis: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, the TI-LFA and Legacy LFA are mutually exclusive, and the commit check will fail and blocks LFA on one instance
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, if configuring LFA (Loop-Free Alternate)/RLFA (Remote LFA)/PPLFA (Per-prefix LFA) in the routing-instance and TI-LFA (topology independent LFA) in the master instance, along with Segment Routing and node-link-protection with post-convergence, the commit check fails and blocks LFA on one instance.

items.synopsis: Memory leak in PKID
items.description: PKID process shows memory usage increase over time after a larger number of certificate verifications. The issue can be recovered by the CLI command "restart pki-service".

items.synopsis: DHCPv6 packets could not be forwarded if it contains the trailer or extra bytes out of the IP stack
items.description: On all Junos QFX5K and EX platforms with DHCPv6 (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol) relay configuration, IPV6 (Internet Protocol) assignment could not take place as the DHCPv6 solicit packets containing extra bytes in DHCPv6 header trailer are not getting forwarded to the DHCP server.

items.synopsis: The traffic drop is observed due to the MAC source address being learned from the wrong direction
items.description: On Junos EX4300/QFX5100/QFX5110/QFX5200/QFX5210 platforms with VXLAN (Virtual Extensible Local Area Network) enabled, when the ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) request is sent from the device, the MAC (Media Access Control) address is learned from the wrong direction which results in the traffic drop.

items.synopsis: QFX5120 reboots due to deletion of EP style interface with native vlan configured
items.description: QFX5120 will reboot without causing a dcpfe crash upon the deletion of EP style (Enterprise Style), and trunk interfaces with multiple IFLs and native VLAN configured.

items.category: RPD infrastructure issues related to NSR, GRES, switchover,
items.synopsis: The traffic drop is observed during the Graceful restart on Junos and Junos Evolved platforms
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, during the time of Graceful restart(GR), the routes in the Multiprotocol Label Switching(mpls).0 table will be updated even when the routing protocols are in the process of re-convergence and have not yet come out of GR. This causes inaccurate routes in the routing table and traffic drop is observed during GR.

items.synopsis: Issue in committing more than 23, 4-byte AS on Junos and Junos Evolved platforms
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, when a 4 byte autonomous system (AS) number is committed with more than 23 as-path in as-path-prepend policy it gives "rpd string" error and the configuration commit fails.

items.synopsis: The rpd process crash is observed when RSVP LSP at Juniper transit/ingress router receives RESV message with RESVCONF object in multi vendor deployment
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms (For QFX5100, only in Virtual Chassis-VC setup) with RSVP (Resource Reservation Protocol) LSP (Label-Switched Path) configured in multi vendor deployment and Juniper router is acting as a transit/ingress router and RESV (Reservation Request) message is received with RESVCONF object from other vendors, rpd process crash will be observed.

items.synopsis: Traffic impact is observed on Junos MX platforms due to the chassisd crash
items.description: On Junos MX240/MX480/MX960 platforms with SCBE3 (Enhanced Switch Control Board), when RE (Routing Engine) is switched over by any event, the chassisd crash is seen on the new master RE due to which all the line cards will reset and the traffic will be impacted.

items.category: Bug and Review Tracking for Segment routing traffic eng
items.synopsis: The traffic blackhole will be observed when the SRTE shortcut is configured
items.description: On Junos platforms, when the MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching) packet reaches the destination router, it will have a label that is unknown to the destination router due to a label POP operation miss at the ingress router resulting in the traffic black hole in the scenario SR-MPLS (Segment Routing With Multiprotocol Label Switching) + traffic engineering shortcut is configured.

items.synopsis: Traffic drop caused by PFE memory leak on SRX platforms
items.description: On Junos SRX platforms enrolled into ATP (Advanced Threat Prevention) cloud, memory leak is observed in the PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) while deletion of few of the signatures which have no hash value. This memory leak results in traffic loss.

items.category: Stout cards (MPC7, MPC8, MPC9) microkernel issues
items.synopsis: FPC crash observed when the ASIC usage is high
items.description: On platforms with MS-MPC/MPC1/2/3/4/5/6/7/8/9/JNP10K-LC2101/JNP10003-LC2103/JNP10K-LC480 line cards and EX9200/EX9204/EX9208/EX9214/EX9251/EX9253 series devices, route churn (add or deletes) when the ASIC usage crosses a threshold (ASIC usage is high) which leads to a FPC crash.

items.category: ZT/YTpfe bridging, learning, stp, oam, irb software
items.synopsis: Not all MAC addresses are learnt for some VPLS instances
items.description: On MX platforms with specific line cards(MPC10, MPC11 & LC9600), when the CLI "clear vpls mac-table" is executed, all the MAC addresses are not learned for some VPLS instances. This will lead to traffic loss due to MAC table not having all the MAC addresses.

items.category: Issues related to broadband edge apps (PPP, DHCP) on Trio ch
items.synopsis: The line card abruptly reboots when ISSU is performed
items.description: On platforms supporting MPC3E/MPC4E/T4000-FPC5/EX9200-4QS/EX9200-2C-8XS/EX9200-MPC/EX9200-32XS/SRX5K-SPC-4-15-320/SRX5K-MPC, the line card abruptly rebooted with a process crash when ISSU (In-Service Software Upgrade) is performed without properly disabling Jflow.

items.synopsis: On certain Junos MX platforms queue buffer-size temporal computation is not happening correctly
items.description: On certain Junos MX platforms, if a queue's buffer size is configured as temporal value and the transmit-rate/guaranteed-rate is not configured as absolute value at COS (Class of Service) schedulers or traffic-control-profile level, then a very low queue depth buffer gets allocated to the queue. This will lead to aggressive tail-drops on the queue.

items.synopsis: Traffic drop would be observed while restarting the chassis-control
items.description: On MX platforms with MPC1 to MPC9 line cards, while restarting chassis-control, the line card crashes as the watchdog timer panics due to an internal thread being too busy seemingly finding if a particular term-based filter has a term with then port-mirror-instance <> for a particular instance name.

items.category: Trio pfe bridging, learning, stp, oam, irb software
items.synopsis: Host communication does not work in EVPN-L2VPN-CCC setup
items.description: On Junos MX platforms, in Ethernet Virtual Private Networks-Layer 2 Virtual Private Networks-Circuit Cross-Connect (EVPN-L2VPN-CCC) setup, the integrated routing and bridging (IRB) interface over access logical tunnel (LT) interface is configured, it is sending vlan tagged packet on the access port and not removing it causing the host communication to break.

items.synopsis: In a rare case FPC crashes and reboots generating a core
items.description: On all Junos platforms, in a rare scenario, GRES (Graceful Routing Engine switchover) may result in LACP (Link Aggregation Control Protocol) on the new master being down which may cause an FPC crash.

items.category: Configuration mgmt, ffp, load-action, commit processing
items.synopsis: The mustd process may crash on all platforms
items.description: With a large-scale configuration, in rare cases, the mustd process might crash. The mustd process, which is responsible for configuration constraint checks, might crash on commit, leading to commit failure.

items.synopsis: Load replace via XML NetConf will not work
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, the load replace operation through XML NetConf will fail.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: The 'load replace' operation might result in mustd and mgd crash
items.description: On Junos and Junos Evolved platforms with 'apply-group' configured, the mustd and mgd processes might crash when the 'load replace' operation is performed. When this happens, 'apply-groups' will get deleted internally and the respective hierarchies will not be notified.

items.synopsis: < ok/> response is getting generated along with < rpc-error>
items.description: When maximum-password-length is configured and the user tries to configure password whose length exceeds configured maximum-password-length, there is an error and the '' tag is emitted. (Ideally '' tag should not be emitted in an error scenario.) The configuration does not get committed.

items.synopsis: Configuration CLI to set temperature tresholds for ZR/ZRM optics is hidden
items.description: On ACX7100-32C and ACX7100-48L platforms the configuration option to set temperature tresholds for ZR/ZRM optics is hidden.

items.category: MX YT-ZF Linecards Fabric Software Category
items.synopsis: Traffic loss will be observed during the ungraceful removal of a switch fabric board
items.description: On MX10K platforms with LC2101, when ungraceful Switch Fabric Boards (SFB) offline operation is performed results in a Packet Loss Duration (PLD) higher than 2000 milliseconds, leading to observed packet loss

items.synopsis: The BGP sessions will flap after the RE switchover
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms with dual RE (Routing Engine) or VC (Virtual Chassis) with NSR enabled scenarios, in some rare BGP scaled scenarios upon RE switchover the new Master RE will send out a route refresh message to all the peers, which is not expected. This will eventually lead to the BGP session flap.

items.synopsis: Virtual Chassis formation will not happen automatically on all EX platforms except EX4400 after zeroize
items.description: Virtual Chassis members are not forming Virtual Chassis on all EX platforms except EX4400 due to cross connection of VC links in specific ring topology setup after zeroize. Each device will function as standalone.

items.synopsis: The 'input-vlan-map push' operation will not work on double-tagged frames
items.description: On Junos EX/QFX5120 platforms with QinQ setup packets with multicast payloads such as OSPF (Open Shortest Path First)/ISIS (Intermediate. System to Intermediate System), when 'input-vlan-map push' is configured to push an outer VLAN (Virtual Local Area Network) tag on to a double-tagged frame, the egressing frame will be tagged incorrectly. Instead of a push operation, the outer VLAN tag of the ingressing double-tagged frame will be swapped and sent out. This results in unexpected behavior or traffic loss as such protocol packets will not have the expected VLAN tag information.

items.synopsis: A heap memory leak will be seen when P2MP LSP MBB events happened
items.description: On PTX3000 and PTX5000 platforms, nodes having Point-to-MultiPoint (P2MP) MPLS label switched path (LSP) passing through them will show a slow increase in Flexible PIC Concentrators (FPC) heap memory utilization when there are P2MP LSP Make-Before-Break (MBB) events happened and when adaptive load balancing (ALB) is enabled on the aggregated ethernet (AE) interface. FPC may crash if the memory leak persists for an extended period.

items.synopsis: Directly connected neighbour via AE becomes unreachable if the member interfaces of AE are swapped and if one AE has VLAN and the other doesn't
items.description: On MPC10E line cards based MX platforms with AE (Aggregated Ethernet) interface configured with Link Aggregation Control Protocol (LACP), subscriber management and auto-configure statement enabled, ping to neighbour fails post swapping member-interfaces between two AE (one with VLAN configuration and the other without VLAN configuration). Traffic forwarding on respective interfaces will be impacted as interface is moved from AE having VLAN to AE not having VLAN.

items.synopsis: The rpd process crash is observed when TI-LFA feature is enabled
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms with TI-LFA (Topology-Independent Loop-Free Alternate) feature enabled, when IP address is removed from one interface and is assigned to another interface in the same commit, the rpd process crashes affecting routing control plane.

items.synopsis: After this PR fix, to enable the xSTP support in ephemeral DB, below config command needs to be used: "set protocols layer2-control ephemeral-db-support"
items.description: After this PR fix, by default xSTP will not be supported in ephemeral-db mode. "set protocols layer2-control ephemeral-db-support" needs to be used to enable the xSTP support in ephemeral-db mode.

items.synopsis: The dcpfe process will crash due to memory fragmentation
items.description: On Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, the dcpfe (Dense Concentrator Packet Forwarding Engine) process crash will be observed due to memory fragmentation issue. This is a very rare case and would impact traffic as due to dcpfe failure the PFE restarts, so the interfaces will flap.

items.synopsis: Traffic drop will be observed after extended-vni-list configuration change with EVPN-VXLAN scenario
items.description: On Junos QFX5100/QFX5110/QFX5120/QFX5200/QFX5210/EX4100/EX4300-MP/EX4400-XX platforms having Ethernet VPN-Virtual Extensible LAN (EVPN-VXLAN) configured if extended-vni-list configuration is deleted, the network interface is flapped and when extended-vni-list is added back due to this traffic using the Flood NH (BUM) on the device will be lost.

items.category: Issues related to dynamic-tunnels routing infrastructure
items.synopsis: Traffic is getting dropped when using GRE NH-based dynamic tunnel is up with GRE Key
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms that support MPLS(Multi-Protocol Label Switching) over GRE (Generic Routing Encapsulation) and have dynamic tunnel configured the traffic can get dropped. This issue is seen when IPv4 traffic is sent and the NH (Next Hop) is a GRE-based dynamic tunnel with a GRE key, the traffic can get dropped even though the tunnel is in up state.

items.synopsis: rpd core at #2 0x00007f9b2512742c in __assert_fail_base (fmt=0x7f9b2528bae8 "%s%s%s:%u: %s%sAssertion `%s' failed.\n%n", assertion=0x55be37507a48 "nh_idx_t_getval(nhid) == nh_idx_t_getval(rt_nexthops_nhid(rtnh))", file=0x55be375077e8 "../../../../../../../../src/layer3/ usr.sbin/rpd/lib/krt/ common/krt_ack.c", line=1306, function=) at assert.c:92
items.description: RPD core is sometimes seen if there are many unilist nexthop with identical key values but different metric in Evo, esp when ACK is requested for those nexthops

items.synopsis: Device crash and control plane traffic gets impacted on Junos platforms
items.description: On all Junos platforms, due to a timing issue, when monitor traffic is enabled on loopback interface (for debug purpose), in the presence of local TCP (Transmission Control Protocol) packet flow, it is observed that the device crashes and traffic gets impacted.

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: After the device reboot BGP sessions configured with authentication will be down
items.description: On all EX4100 platforms, after the device reboot, BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) peers with authentication remain down as the keyadmin utility is not invoked causing the kernel database to not populate with MD5 configuration.

items.synopsis: Memory leak is observed on all Junos SRX platforms with http-persist and http-reassembly configuration
items.description: On all Junos SRX platforms with http-persist and http-reassembly configuration when firewall policy is attached with enhanced or redirect WF (Web Filtering) policy, memory leak will be observed in PFE (Packet Forwarding Engine) which leads to traffic drop.
